cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: A Valuable Safeguard
cards.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've drawn boxes round every signature like you did. Nobody goes on the trip until all the boxes are checked.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was marking the signatures we couldn't read. Those others are fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, a complete legibility check. Best have another teacher look before we let anyone board.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: June can read them, but she's supervising the children on the bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll wait for her to finish. I wouldn't pull her away from a safety job.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies illegibility markings as universal checks; B2 corrects their purpose. A3 covers with complete check and A5 praises waiting for safety supervision.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 selective marks produce A3 universal check; B4 June already supervising on bus changes the timing to waiting for her.

relationship.evidence: B2 explains useful marks and B4 locates a competent checker who is occupied with children.

heightening.evidence: A5 treats B4 occupied checker as a reason to wait rather than pull her away.

specificity.evidence: A1 signatures and trip, A3 boarding and B4 teacher supervision establish school departure.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 safety job is a direct reason to B for waiting, not a summary aimed at the evaluator.
